title: pdf-press project configuration
description: Per-project configuration for the pdf-press enterprise architecture PDF pipeline. Lives at docs/architecture/.pdf-press.config.json. Every visual and structural decision is a token here; nothing is hardcoded in the pipeline.

schemaVersion.description: Config contract version. Bumped only on a breaking key change.

pipelineVersion.description: Version of assets/pipeline/ this project was scaffolded from. The skill compares it to its own PIPELINE_VERSION and offers an upgrade when behind.

name.description: Short slug used in output filenames, e.g. "acme".

title.description: Document title on the cover, per language.

version.description: Document version shown on the cover and in the footer stamp.

policy.description: "config" (recommended) uses `value` verbatim — builds are byte-reproducible. "date" derives vYYYY.MM at build time and BREAKS reproducibility across months.

date.description: Fixed date used for PDF /CreationDate and /ModDate. Required when policy is "config" — a wall-clock timestamp would make every rebuild a different file.

dir.description: Output directory, relative to the config file (docs/architecture/). "." keeps PDFs beside the document set; ".." writes them one level above it, where nobody looks. For an issued document set, point this at a dated folder such as "releases/2026-07-27" and bump it when cutting the next release.

languages.description: Language codes. Every i18n string and every figure label must cover all of them — lint fails otherwise.

editions.description: One entry per audience. Keys become the {edition} filename token.

title.description: Optional per-edition document title, overriding project.title — for an edition that is a different document (e.g. a supplier communication spec) sharing the project's pipeline and identity.

subtitle.description: Optional per-edition subtitle, overriding project.subtitle. Only consulted when the edition also overrides title.

marking.description: Confidentiality marking on the cover and in the footer, e.g. "Confidential — for partner use".

footerLeft.description: Left-hand footer line on every page after the cover.

figures.description: Figure slugs this edition may embed. Lint fails on any {{fig:…}} in the edition's content that is not listed here — this is the scope gate that stops internal figures leaking into an external document.

scopeNote.description: Human note on what this edition deliberately omits. Not rendered; read by the skill when authoring.

content.description: Derive this edition's content from another edition's file at build time instead of authoring a twin that drifts. One tagged master, N audience renderings.

from.description: Edition whose content file is the source (e.g. "internal-spec").

stripStatus.description: Strip data-status/data-source attributes from the derived body — the audience sees clean normative prose while the master stays lint-truthful.

dropClasses.description: Top-level <section> elements carrying any of these classes are removed from the derived body (e.g. ["internal-only"]). Sections only, no nesting — an inline internal-only fragment belongs in its own section.

deprecated.description: Mark this edition as superseded: its PDF is written as <name>.deprecated.pdf and its metadata carries [DEPRECATED]. Use when an edition still builds (so it stays reproducible) but must not be mistaken for the current deliverable. Renaming the file by hand does not work — the next build restores the pattern name.

contentWidth.description: Figure viewBox width equal to the printable content width. Every figure must use exactly this — that is what makes stroke weights and label sizes consistent across figures.

colors.description: Structural palette. Every key becomes a CSS custom property (paper -> --paper).

signals.description: Semantic figure palette: name -> [stroke, wash]. These colors carry MEANING in figures (pv=amber, battery=green …), never decoration. The figure linter allows only these plus the structural palette.

scale.description: Type scale in pt. Omitted keys fall back to the pipeline defaults.

style.description: hero-fill = full-bleed brand cover with motif streaks; panel = paper cover with a brand rule; minimal = type only.

motif.description: Short brand glyph run used as a kicker prefix and on the edition tag, e.g. "///". Empty disables it.

heightMm.description: Cover height. Defaults to one millimetre under the resolved page height so the cover never spills a blank second page; a value that does not fit the page size is clamped with a warning.

background.description: Cover background for hero-fill. Defaults to brand. Set this when the brand accent colour is not the right full-bleed field (e.g. a dark navy cover with a teal accent used elsewhere).

ink.description: Cover text colour. Defaults to ink. Required for a dark cover.background, where the body ink would be unreadable.

logo.description: Path to an SVG logo, relative to the config file. Inlined on the cover and in the endmark. Omit for a type-only document.

footer.description: Post-render footer stamp (page numbers + edition line), drawn with reportlab.

fontFile.description: TTF path relative to the config file. Falls back to Helvetica when absent — set it, or Czech diacritics may render wrong.

color.description: Stamp colour. Prefer a theme.colors KEY (e.g. "dim") so it stays inside the palette the linter checks; a raw [r,g,b] triple is accepted but warned about.

pageWord.description: The word before "3 / 18", per language. Defaults to "page" for en and the language code otherwise — set it for every language you ship.

lint.description: Mechanical enforcement of the figure conventions. This is what keeps a hand-drawn SVG set looking like one system.

rx.description: Required corner radius on box rects.

fontSizes.description: The only permitted svg text font-size values: group title / body label / annotation.

allowExtraColors.description: Escape hatch for a color that is genuinely outside the palette. Every entry needs a reason in the commit message.

minRenderedPt.description: Readable floor for figure text ON PAPER. A figure is scaled to the text column, so an authored size of 8 at contentWidth 760 lands at ~5.07pt on A4 — enforcing the authored value alone misses this. 5.0 suits the annotation tier; raise to 6.0 when the document has an accessibility requirement or will be printed below A4.

doctrine.description: Content rules the linter enforces so the document stays contractually honest.

statusTags.description: Allowed values of data-status on a normative block.

requireStatusOnNormative.description: A block containing a normative marker (must/shall/musí) must carry data-status. Stops the document promising behavior the system does not have.

normativeMarkers.description: Per-language words that make a sentence normative.

requireSourceOnStatus.description: An IMPLEMENTED block must also carry data-source with a repo path (file or file:line). Facts get receipts.

statusLabels.description: Per-status printed wording, per language: {"IMPLEMENTED": {"cs": "IMPLEMENTOVÁNO", "en": "IMPLEMENTED"}}. The badge is drawn by CSS from data-status, so an untranslated document stamps every normative Czech sentence with an English word.

typography.description: Micro-typography applied to text nodes at build time, per language. Omit for sane defaults (Czech/Slovak get the full ČSN 01 6910 set). Set a language to [] to disable.

additionalProperties.description: prepositions = one-letter preposition may not end a line · units = bind a number to its unit · operators = bind < ≤ ≥ to the number · dashes = an em dash may not start a line · references = kap./§/obr. bind to the number · beforeCode = a short word may not be stranded before an inline identifier

glossary.description: Terminology policy checked by lint: foreign technical terms whose treatment in this document must be consistent.

term.description: The term as it appears in prose (case-insensitive, word-boundary).

prefer.description: What to write instead. Omit to allow the term but still count its uses.

note.description: Why — shown in the lint message.

allow.description: true = an accepted loanword; lint stays silent but the term stays inventoried.

langs.description: Languages this rule applies to (e.g. ["cs"]). Omit to apply to every language.

pagination.description: Per-project pagination thresholds for pagecheck.py; each key overrides that check's default.

minFillRatio.description: A page filled less than this is reported as suspiciously empty.

minLastPageFill.description: The final page may be short, but not a single stray line.

maxLinesAfterHeading.description: A heading with no more than this many lines beneath it is stranded at a page foot.

marginTolerancePt.description: Slack in points before a margin overrun counts as a violation.

widowGapFactor.description: Gap divided by median leading above which a page's top line reads as a widow.

path.description: Chrome/Chromium binary. Autodetected when null; ARCH_SPEC_CHROME overrides both.

virtualTimeBudgetMs.description: Raise if large figures or webfonts are not fully laid out at capture.

i18nString.description: Language code -> string. Must cover every entry in `languages`.

stack.description: CSS fallback appended after family, e.g. "sans-serif".

faces.description: @font-face sources. Empty means the family is expected to be installed or is a generic stack.

src.description: Path relative to the config file.
